_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on mini_2gpu_2nic. 4 hosts x 2 GPUs, each GPU owns its own 100Gbps NIC (2 uplinks per host), 2 leaves / 2 spines. The only mini variant that can run hierarchically: mini_1gpu_1nic has no host tier to fold, and mini_2gpu_1nic's shared NIC hangs off the PCIe root complex, which cannot be a cell (see its .topo). milp_chunking='cell': one MILP chunk = one host's chunks for one destination-cell set. Smallest model; voids multipath on hosts with more than one uplink -- the tractability fallback. SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs, no cut-through optimism). switch_copy is forced off at MILP levels anyway (copy happens at hosts). Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md.
